hypothesis: Replacing the fixed session number with a gate-derived dynamic directive reduces known stale next-session assertions from 1 to 0 while preserving the operational action and human-review boundary.
metric: known stale next-session assertions in current STATE.md
limitations: The full session overhead includes fresh clone, mandatory reading, branch and PR audit, gate/checkpoint/coverage, edit, report, tests, site build, documentation, checkpoint refresh and publication. The metric captures removal of one known contradiction, not time, tokens, prevention of all concurrency failures, general-agent performance or LLM quality.
